# EggerMath — Free GBA & GBC Emulator

> Play Game Boy Advance and Game Boy Color games in your browser. Free, no downloads required.

## About
EggerMath is a free, browser-based Game Boy Advance and Game Boy Color emulator powered by mGBA WebAssembly. Play GBA and GBC games directly in Chrome, Firefox, Edge, or Safari on any device — phone, tablet, or desktop.

## Key Features
- Runs entirely in the browser via WebAssembly (mGBA engine)
- Supports both GBA and GBC ROMs (.gba, .zip, .gb, .gbc)
- No software installation required
- Save states with 10 slots (F5/F9/F7)
- Auto-save every 30 seconds via IndexedDB
- Fast forward (2x/4x speed)
- Mobile touch controls
- Custom keyboard controls
- Drag-and-drop ROM upload
- 25+ popular GBA and GBC games available for one-click play
- ROM caching for instant repeat plays

## How to Play
1. Open https://www.eggermath.com/gba-emulator-web/
2. Click a game from the library, or drag-and-drop your own .gba, .zip, .gb, or .gbc ROM file
3. Use keyboard or touch controls to play

## Keyboard Controls
- D-Pad: WASD or Arrow Keys
- A Button: K
- B Button: J
- L Shoulder: Q
- R Shoulder: E
- Start: Enter
- Select: Right Shift
- Save State: F5
- Load State: F9
- Switch Save Slot: F7

## Technical Details
- Emulator engine: mGBA (compiled to WebAssembly)
- License: MPL 2.0 (emulator engine)
- Saves stored locally via IndexedDB (never uploaded)
- Service worker for offline caching
- Google Analytics: G-44ZYW1XML3
- Hosted on Render
